baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُ بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْـَٔمُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Directed worship, a night-day temporal merism, and explicit negation of repetition-fatigue combine into uninterrupted doxology.

activation_trace.role: Worship through praise, prayer, and remembrance supplies the literal act and its devotional function.
Night and its darkness supply one temporal pole of the continuous span.
Daylight supplies the opposite temporal pole, completing the full cycle.
Boredom caused by long repetition is explicitly negated, making constancy qualitative rather than merely frequent.

changed_reading.before: Those near God praise Him often.
changed_reading.after: Their God-directed worship fills both temporal poles, and repetition never turns the act into exhausted routine.

baseline_models.mechanism: The conditional places self-exalting refusal opposite authenticated nearness to the sovereign Lord; status is measured by proximity expressed as service.

activation_trace.role: Human self-exaltation and refusal of truth supply the failed claim to greatness.
Nearness and presence supply the counter-status of those who remain in acknowledged relation.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the authority by which rank is measured.
Declaring God free of defect makes humble service the enacted correction to self-magnification.

changed_reading.before: If humans refuse worship, superior beings replace them.
changed_reading.after: The contrast exposes claimed human elevation as distance from the Lord, while real elevation is nearness enacted as self-effacing praise.

baseline_models.mechanism: The swimming and running branch of praise places the act inside the alternation of night and day as sustained movement, not only repeated utterance.

activation_trace.role: Swimming, running, and celestial motion supply a kinetic image for the praise.
Night supplies the dark phase through which the activity continues.
Day supplies the open bright phase of the same recurring field.
Negated fatigue keeps the motion continuous across recurring phases.

changed_reading.before: Praise is an endless vocal formula.
changed_reading.after: Praise may also name unbroken, God-oriented motion or service carried through the whole temporal cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heaven and earth answer willingly, each heaven receives an assigned command, and the nearest heaven is guarded; angelic praise therefore reads as participation in an ordered and willingly sustained cosmos.

activation_trace.role: Celestial running and swimming provide the focus-side image of active cosmic service.
Willing obedience supplies the disposition that turns cosmic motion into responsive service.
Completed and executed making supplies an ordered created framework for the service.
An assigned command supplies differentiated function within each heaven.
Continuous guarding and observance supply a durable operational aspect of praise.

structural_cues: 41:11 records a willing cosmic response, and 41:12 assigns and guards the heavens before 41:38 names unwearying praise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies willing compliance, assigned commands, guarding, and a kinetic praise branch; I infer that praise can enact cosmic order. A live alternative is that these are separate acts and the focus means verbal glorification only.

changed_reading.before: The attendants repeat praise inside an already ordered universe.
changed_reading.after: Their praise can be heard as the willing, continuous performance by which assigned cosmic order remains active.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier occurrence defines arrogance as an earthly claim to unmatched force, while the focus answers it with nearness, praise, and endurance rather than rival force.

activation_trace.role: Nearness to the Lord supplies the alternative measure of genuine standing.
The repeated arrogance branch identifies the focus condition with refusal grounded in self-exaltation.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies the force metric the arrogant use and the Creator exceeds.
Creation supplies the dependency that invalidates a creature's claim to autonomous superior force.

structural_cues: 41:15 and 41:38 repeat the same form of the arrogance verb; the first expands it with the boast 'who is stronger than us?'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical recurrence, a force boast, creaturehood, and focus-side nearness; I infer a deliberate replacement of force-rank with service-rank. The narrower alternative is only a historical example followed by a general warning.

changed_reading.after: It answers a defined fantasy of creaturely force: true standing is not being strongest on earth but being near the Creator in tireless service.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bodily faculties become witnesses because God makes every thing articulate; this opens praise as divinely enabled disclosure by created agents, not speech imagined as autonomous possession.

activation_trace.role: Glorification as declaring God free of defect supplies the focus act of truthful disclosure.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies an embodied mode of truth-bearing.
God-given articulation supplies the causal bridge from created faculty to expressed testimony.
The broad category of an intelligible created thing widens the capacity for God-enabled articulation.

structural_cues: 41:20-21 moves from organs witnessing to the statement that God made every thing speak.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created witnesses and God-enabled articulation; I infer that angelic praise is likewise dependent disclosure embedded in creaturely function. A live alternative limits the speech claim to judgment testimony and leaves praise conventionally vocal.

changed_reading.before: Angels possess an inexhaustible ability to utter praise.
changed_reading.after: Their praise is an unbroken created witness whose power to disclose truth remains continuously given by God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same surah names angels descending to steadfast humans and undertaking protective alliance; being 'at your Lord' therefore functions as rank and allegiance compatible with movement and mission.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and presence supply the focus relation whose spatial fixity is being tested.
Going, coming, and free movement supply a focus-side capacity for service beyond a fixed station.
Steadfast alignment supplies the human condition to which the descending mission responds.
Descent and arrival supply explicit vertical movement by the angels.
The angel branch identifies the moving agents rather than leaving the descent impersonal.
Protective love and alliance supply an outward-facing mission continuous with divine allegiance.

structural_cues: 41:30 explicitly makes angels descend, and 41:31 gives their first-person claim of alliance in both lives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies angelic descent, alliance, and focus-side nearness; I infer that 'at' marks relational rank rather than confinement. A live alternative is that different angelic groups occupy the two scenes.

changed_reading.before: Those at the Lord remain in a remote heavenly court praising continuously.
changed_reading.after: Their nearness is portable allegiance and rank: they can descend into protective mission without ceasing to be oriented to the Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence requires repelling evil with what is better, patient reception, and refuge from disruptive provocation; unwearying praise becomes a model of response that does not acquire the aggressor's form.

activation_trace.role: Negated weariness supplies durable response under repetition.
God-directed purification and exoneration supply the positive form preserved under pressure.
Removing harm supplies an active counter-movement rather than passive endurance.
Holding the self from reactive collapse supplies the endurance needed for the better response.
Provocation that corrupts relations supplies the repeated pressure being resisted.
Seeking protective refuge supplies the reorientation that prevents mimetic retaliation.

structural_cues: 41:34-36 forms an instruction sequence about better response, patience, provocation, and refuge immediately before the signs and angelic scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a non-mimetic response sequence and negated weariness; I infer that the angelic scene images its stable endpoint. A live alternative keeps the human ethic and angelic praise as adjacent but independent topics.

changed_reading.after: It can also describe unwavering response-form: provocation never converts their God-oriented praise into the arrogance it answers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah classifies night and day with sun and moon as signs, forbids prostration to the luminaries, and redirects worship to their Creator; the focus then locates praise within night and day but directs it 'to Him.'

activation_trace.role: Worshipful praise supplies the correctly directed act.
Night is explicitly presented as a sign and therefore as a medium, not the recipient, of worship.
Daylight is paired with night as the second created sign traversed by praise.
The sun supplies a luminous created object explicitly excluded as worship's target.
The moon and its light supply the second created object explicitly excluded as target.
Bodily lowering supplies the worship posture first prohibited toward signs and then redirected to God.
Creation establishes the asymmetry between the signs and their proper worship recipient.
Submissive worship names the allegiance whose direction the sequence corrects.

structural_cues: 41:37 and 41:38 share the exact night-day pair; the prohibition and redirection immediately precede 'they praise Him by night and day.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared terms, sign-status, prohibited luminary worship, and the focus pronoun 'to Him'; I infer that night and day are coordinates through which worship passes rather than powers receiving it. The narrower alternative treats the pair as temporal merism only.

changed_reading.before: The angels praise continuously, at night and in daytime.
changed_reading.after: Their praise traverses the created signs without stopping at them, modeling how cosmic visibility is passed through to the Creator rather than converted into luminary worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later lexical recurrence says the human never tires of calling for good yet collapses into severed hope under harm and turns away under blessing; the focus's same negated weariness is stable because its object is God rather than desired benefit.

activation_trace.role: Negated boredom from prolonged repetition supplies the shared predicate whose objects are contrasted.
God-directed worship supplies the stable object of angelic persistence.
The exact repeated predicate supplies a human persistence that initially resembles angelic tirelessness.
Calling that draws a desired good toward the caller supplies the self-benefit object of persistence.
Hope cut off under harm reveals that the apparent persistence is condition-dependent.
A second image of severed hope intensifies the abrupt collapse.
Moving far away under blessing supplies the opposite instability: success also breaks orientation.
Turning one's side away supplies the bodily-social form of estrangement.
Extended calling under harm confirms that need, rather than allegiance, governs the human rhythm.

structural_cues: 41:38 and 41:49 repeat لَا يَسْأَمُ with different subjects and objects; 41:49-51 then tests the human subject under harm and blessing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact predicate recurrence and opposite reactions to changing fortune; I infer that the contrast diagnoses persistence by its object. A live alternative is that both clauses merely emphasize duration without an intended ethical comparison.

changed_reading.before: Never tiring is simply an angelic quantity of repetition.
changed_reading.after: The phrase distinguishes two tirelessnesses: appetite repeats while benefit is imaginable, but angelic praise remains God-oriented across every change of condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: A human who claims received mercy as personal possession, doubts the Hour, and presumes a favorable outcome 'with Him' counterfeits the focus's 'those at your Lord'; actual nearness is service, not projected entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and standing before the Lord supply the authenticated relation.
Lordship and ownership make tireless service, rather than self-possession, the grammar of nearness.
Received mercy supplies the gift that the human immediately redescribes as personal due.
Unsettled supposition supplies the doubted judgment and unsupported favorable projection.
The repeated Lord relation makes the later claim directly comparable to the focus relation.
The exact nearness construction supplies a claimed favorable standing without corresponding allegiance.

structural_cues: 41:50 repeats both 'my Lord' and 'with Him' but frames them inside 'this is mine' and doubt of the Hour.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact relational recurrence inside possessive presumption; I infer that 41:38 contrasts real and imagined nearness. A live alternative reads the later claim as misguided hope but not a deliberate echo of the angelic station.

changed_reading.before: Those at the Lord occupy a privileged location.
changed_reading.after: Their nearness is authenticated by tireless God-directed service, exposing self-awarded expectation 'with Him' as entitlement rather than proximity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Signs extend across far horizons and inner selves while the Lord witnesses every thing and encompasses every thing; proximity to Him therefore need not describe one local coordinate inside the cosmos.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the spatially suggestive focus relation that the closing scope reorients.
Distant horizons supply the outermost spatial reach of disclosed signs.
The self as the thing's own identity supplies the inward pole opposite the horizons.
Presence with witnessing supplies divine immediacy across the outer-inner span.
The repeated Lord relation connects the closing claim directly to the focus station.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and possession removes an external region from which nearness must be measured.

structural_cues: The surah closes with an outer-inner merism, universal witness, and universal encompassing after repeatedly using Lord-nearness language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies horizon-to-self scope, witness, and encompassing; I infer that angelic 'at-ness' is relational immediacy within divine rule, not a mapped distance. A live alternative preserves concrete court imagery alongside divine omnipresence.

changed_reading.before: Nearness to the Lord means occupying the closest heavenly place.
changed_reading.after: Nearness chiefly names unmediated allegiance and presence within an all-encompassing rule, so its continuity is not tied to one cosmic coordinate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses the day sense of نَهَار with the root's river image and joins it to the swimming branch of س ب ح. It remains anchored in the focus roots and is activated by 41:39's water-driven movement, swelling, and life. Downstream prose should mark it only as a material analogy for circulating praise, never as a replacement translation of 'day' or 'glorify.'

activation_trace.role: Swimming and flowing motion supply the moving medium of the analogy.
A river cutting earth with running water supplies the deliberately form-distant current image.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material input that starts the visible cycle.
Earth and vegetation shaking into life supplies responsive motion rather than inert repetition.
Rising and increase supply the expanding phase of the life-bearing current.
Earth revived through water and growth supplies the current's life-producing outcome.

changed_reading.before: Night and day are a clock measuring repeated praise.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cycle becomes a liturgical current: praise moves through creation like water whose repeated passage awakens, lifts, and sustains life.

strongest_changes: The surah's descending and allied angels turn 'at your Lord' from spatial confinement into portable rank and allegiance.
The exact night-day repetition across 41:37-38 makes created signs the medium of worship while excluding sun and moon as its targets.
The exact لَا يَسْأَمُ recurrence in 41:49 distinguishes stable God-oriented tirelessness from appetite-driven persistence that collapses under changed fortune.
Earlier willing cosmic obedience and God-enabled creaturely witness expand praise from vocal repetition into enacted alignment and disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence directly reactivated four focus anchors: arrogance, Lord-nearness, night-day, and weariness. The immediate 41:37-39 frame also placed angelic praise between anti-luminary worship and the earth's water-driven revival.
remaining_uncertainties: The motion and operational-service readings depend on carrying non-devotional branches of س ب ح into the focus rather than restricting it to verbal glorification.
Relational rank is a strong account of عِندَ after angelic descent and divine encompassing, but concrete heavenly-court imagery may remain simultaneously live.
The hydrological reading is branch-backed but cross-domain and should remain an explicitly qualified analogy.
